description: This file is a PHP source file for the 'SetInstallationConfig.php' script, which appears to be part of the installation process for vtiger CRM. It manages configuration inputs such as database connection details, site URL, and admin user setup through an HTML form embedded within PHP code. It handles session variables, includes external dependencies, and outputs an HTML page for user input during installation.

classes.name: Installation_Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing database options for installation.

methods.name: Installation_Utils::getDbOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the available database types supported during installation.
